You will work on a wide range of matters relating to financial regulation, fund structuring and compliance. In doing so, you will combine in-depth legal expertise with a pragmatic approach and maintain close contact with clients and regulators. Building relationships with (new) clients is a key part of this role. 
Your duties will include: 
• Advising clients on Dutch and European financial regulation and supervisory issues. 
• Assisting with the establishment, structuring and management of investment funds and alternative fund structures. 
• Providing support with licensing processes, registrations and compliance matters in dealings with regulators such as the AFM. 
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating fund documentation, investment and management agreements. 
• Conducting legal due diligence reviews and contributing to the further growth of the practice and client relationships. What will you bring? 
• A completed Master's degree in Dutch or European Financial Law.
